question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Get away
solution:
The correct answer is: **To leave**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The idiom "**Get away**" means to leave or escape from a person or place. (किसी व्यक्ति या स्थान से दूर जाना या बचना)

 
 
• Example -* **We walked to the next beach to get away__ from the crowds.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom "**Get away**" is "**To leave**"

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.
